note: Vegetation indices of the AeroNexus Farming Guide. All are normalised differences (a - b) / (a + b) of two bands of the ODM multispectral orthophoto. Without a reflectance panel the values are RELATIVE (comparable within one flight only).

indices.name: NDVI
indices.description: Biomass and vitality; saturates in dense canopies

indices.name: NDRE
indices.description: Chlorophyll / nitrogen status, also in dense canopies

indices.name: GNDVI
indices.description: Chlorophyll content, more sensitive than NDVI in mid season
